question: Into what does all of that go in dissolution, and what obligation arises to have that explained?
premises: There is a dissolution into which something goes.
All of that is the object of inquiry.
The speaker requests that all of it be told.
inference: A complete account of the locus and scope of dissolution is requested.
uncertainties: The referent of 'all of that' is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: And indeed, into what does it go in dissolution? Tell me all of that.
